purpose: Evaluate the actual literal PNG training cost of the predetermined represented-feasible inward candidate against an exactly reproduced saved incumbent, using one paired direct forward probe per eligible saved context. This is a necessary actual-pipeline test toward improved full recovery, not a replacement for that objective.

selection.population: Visit all24 original report rows and all17 saved fits in original order; retain16 no-certificate fits and all pre-fit/exception rows. Every qualified inward context receives the same paired policy; no successful-case filtering.
selection.candidate: Use exactly new_census.candidates[new_census.selected_index], requiring selected_index0, saved physical floats matching their hex values, all5gates true, no arithmetic unknowns and complete saved census. Never reconstruct anchor+span*d, rerank128corners, generate another point or fall back to another corner.
selection.incumbent: Use the enclosing iteration.incumbent_candidate_index, requiring source_snapshot.candidate_index and mean_input_sha256 and inward.reconstructed.anchor agree with that exact phase candidate. Do not substitute final best or a different iteration.
selection.forbidden: No reserved/reference scoring, geometry truth, optimizer, preparation, brightness profiling, event/face/census search, alternative corner, retry or cache credit.

training_inputs.source: The enclosing refinement.details.preflight_input_snapshot supplies source_shape,origin,pitch,optical_kernel,output_shape,output_to_source_index,post_kernel,ordered queries,target,weights,bounds and level_bounds. Verify agreement with outer input_snapshot and observed-fit-input.json fields; observed observations are target.
training_inputs.unused: reserved_queries and all reference/capture arrays are excluded from evaluation, cost and selection. All106 original artifacts are hashed for provenance without scoring their values.
training_inputs.levels: Each seven-coordinate tuple carries its own two saved brightness levels, held fixed for that evaluation. They may differ between incumbent and candidate. No brightness refit, shared-level substitution or variable projection.
training_inputs.geometry: centre=p[:2],radius=p[2],fraction=p[3],normal=(math.cos(p[4]),math.sin(p[4])). Preserve existing aperture normal canonicalization, source-cell origin and supplied affine map exactly; no half-pixel correction, crop or kernel renormalization is added.

pipeline.coverage: Unchanged finite_aperture.segment_cell_coverage with the saved geometry/source grid.
pipeline.acquisition: Unchanged finite_acquisition.acquisition_mean with those cell fractions, saved levels and settings, ordered training queries, srgb8=True and exact required max_work.
pipeline.stage_order: Original float32 coverage storage, brightness mixing, reflected optical correlation, source sRGB8 encode, sequential float32 Rec709 decode, Keys sampling and post kernel. No substitute renderer or analytic surrogate.
pipeline.retention: Retain all7 fresh stages with dtype/shape/raw-byte SHA256/values, statuses, input hash, required/performed work, workspace and exact input float/hex tuples for both phases.
pipeline.paired_order: Incumbent first, predetermined candidate second. Attempt each at most once after the full pair is reserved. Historical baseline mismatch does not trigger a retry or different candidate; retain both raw outcomes but withhold interpretation. If an operator fails, retain the failure and bounded second-attempt result independently.

historical_baseline_qualification.required: Require saved candidate identity/anchor and mean input SHA, source_snapshot mean SHA, exact ordered135 predictions/raw residuals/weighted residuals/cost, and bitwise dtype/shape/hash/value equality of all3 archived context stages. Compare to archived records, not two freshly equal results or reference capture.
historical_baseline_qualification.source_codes: Also check the phase code archive entry bound to that candidate where retained. A missing required context stage, inconsistent archived hash or mismatch is protocol_failure, not an improvement or permission to relax equality.

actual_cost.raw: float64 target-prediction in original ordered training queries.
actual_cost.weighted: weights multiply raw residuals, not square-root weights. Require finite positive saved weights and finite prediction/raw/weighted values; refuse nonzero raw residual that becomes zero when weighted.
actual_cost.squared_norm: norm=math.hypot(*weighted_residual); refuse nonfinite or norm>sqrt(float_max), then cost=norm*norm; refuse nonzero norm with cost0. Match the old rounded-mode seam without division by query count or uncertainty reweighting.
actual_cost.acceptance: Only candidate_cost < replayed_incumbent_cost, with exact strict comparison and no tolerance, decides training-cost acceptance after the historical incumbent replay qualifies.
actual_cost.code_patterns: Retain full actual source uint8 arrays, all changed row-major source indices, selected source62 code93->92 target hit and every collateral change separately. Target/pattern preservation is a diagnostic, never an additional veto on a genuine strict cost decrease.

work.policy: Preflight and reserve the entire2-evaluation pair before its first operator call. Append reservations to the exact saved full-fit used totals under its unchanged global caps. No cache credit, borrowed phase budget or new runtime grant.
work.call_counters: Two logical forward evaluations comprise at most2 aperture coverage calls and2 acquisition_mean calls. Record logical reservations, phase attempts, operator attempts, reported work and held/charged reservations separately.
work.failures: Reservations stay held and count against caps on every failure. Aperture has no independent work report: retain reported=None/opaque while charging its169cell reservation. Invalid/absent/out-of-range acquisition work retains the full reserved stage charge and marks the phase unresolved/protocol-invalid; never credit opaque failures as zero work.

source_lanes: Original recovery100/c1a9330, old physical census104/b649ea3, inward108/66df525 and new paired probe112 are separate exact closures. Preserve every old byte/map/outcome. Gate all112 current files and all report/census/inward/106artifact saved bindings before backend import/calls and again after completion/failure.
binding_policy: Hash the exact report/census/inward/fit bytes that are parsed. Keep independent after-checks for every artifact even if an earlier artifact is missing or changed. Retain all late errors; late binding failures override any top-level or contextual acceptance labels without erasing computed facts.
first_execution_gate: All108 previous bytes/modes unchanged. Independently static-review new runner, independent tests, admission and guide; commit/hash all112 before first import, collection, control or model/operator call. First selected invented-data controls must pass terminally before the first saved paired probe. Preserve first source/log/handle/result/exit; any later correction requires a separate admission and files.
output_policy: Fresh JSON in an existing parent; refuse occupied files, symlinks and missing parents before imports/calls. Retain all24 rows, all17 fit dispositions, exact selected-context identities, both raw phase records, historical baseline comparisons, code-change diagnostics, work reservations/attempts/reports, all failure reasons, source/saved bindings before/after and versions.

outcomes.literal_training_improvement: All required nonzero eligible pairs complete, historical baselines qualify exactly, candidates strictly lower actual training cost and every final binding remains valid. passed=true, exit0.
outcomes.complete_no_improvement: All pairs and baselines fully qualify, but strict actual training-cost improvement is absent. paired_probe_complete=true, acceptance=false, passed=false, exit1; complete negative cost evidence, not a protocol error.
outcomes.paired_unresolved: Work/numerical/operator failure prevents a qualified complete comparison; retain reservations and any raw phase results, passed=false, exit1.
outcomes.protocol_failure: Source, saved identity/inventory/schema, archived baseline reproduction, metadata or before/after binding mismatch; retain raw facts, withhold all acceptance, passed=false, exit1.

qualification_limits: This supplied-pipeline paired probe is not a full24 recovery rerun and cannot replace the unchanged11/12 score or its conditional reserved residuals.
A strict training-cost decrease does not establish recovery targets, nonlinear protected-code preservation, physical fit, unknown-camera adequacy, global convergence or transferred optimality.
Integration of the inward arithmetic into a bounded search still needs a separate source/test/admission freeze, shared runtime work reservations and another complete original24-case study.
No automatic trace/CAD/UI/HTTP change, source-input upload, installation, deployment, native slicer operation or physical acceptance.
